item.title: Commission Fines Councilman John Lee $138,000 for Alleged Ethics Violations
item.description: The Los Angeles City Ethics Commission Wednesday sustained all 10 counts of ethics violations and imposed a penalty of $138,124.32 against Councilman John Lee, who allegedly accepted lavish gifts and misused his position in 2016 and 2017 during a trip to Las Vegas and at various Los Angeles restaurants when he was chief of staff […]

item.description: A 34-year-old man was sentenced Wednesday to 17 years to life in prison for opening fire on a crowd of people, wounding an Uber driver, after he was kicked out of a Fullerton bar four years ago. item.title: Man Fatally Stabbed in Compton Identified

Homicide detectives responded shortly before 10:45 a.m. Friday to the 200 block of South Locust Avenue, between Alondra and Compton boulevards, to conduct a death investigation, according to the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department.
